scientific_integrity: The exact conflict-graph and full-retention formulas and probabilistic limit are analytically proved. The finite checker tests the implementation and exact small instances; it is not a proof of an infinite assertion. Same-model review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic exact optimization holds in dimension two for re-stratification to any larger size. Three-quarter limit and exact no-deletion probability require independent uniform within-stratum jitter, independent coordinate permutation, and target n+1. No CLT or higher-dimensional extension is claimed. Full text of the closely relevant 2017 follow-up could not be inspected; publication priority remains provisional.
title: Optimal planar Latin-hypercube extension and the three-quarter retention law
